newsitem.title: FRANCE: French car sales fall in February.
newsitem.headline: French car sales fall in February.

text.p: New car sales in France fell in February to 133,680, a drop of 24.6 percent from the year-earlier level, or 20.9 percent on a comparable-day basis.

"As in January, the French car market remained in February at the very low levels observed since the end of the rebate programme (on September 30, 1996) and close to the worst sales results recorded in 1993," the French carmakers association CCFA said in a statement detailing the provisional February figures.
It said PSA Peugeot Citroen car sales in France fell 29.4 percent last month, while Renault SA sales fell 19.7 percent. Sales of foreign brands fell 24.1 percent.
For the first two months of 1997, provisional car sales totalled 256,000, down 29.3 percent from 361,919 a year ago.
In January, new car sales fell 33.6 percent.
